title: 第17章 靖安甲兵第18章 射声招揽
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
郑县令给的灵参丸是普通物品，而非有游戏提示的特殊物品。
周元无法判断这些灵参丸的具体效果，不过想来一个县令不至于欺骗他这个乡野少年。
无论如何他把钱花出去了，并且还是当着役丁们的面花出去的。
这样一来不仅减少很多琐事，也平衡役丁小团体内的贫富差距。
“石头，你咋把钱都花了，不是我说你，攒着多好。
回头钱多了讨个婆娘，也好给你们老周家留个后啊。”
“你不说这事儿我还真忘了，你不是刚得了一百一十钱吗，先借给我点。”
“借不了，除了这事儿都好说，我还得给孩子攒钱娶媳妇呐。”
得亏周元手中没钱了，不然总会有几个打主意的，烦也烦死。
现在好了，该他烦别人了，在他的一番努力下，钱虽然没借到多少，倒也落了些实惠。
几个差役念他勇武、自己又平白得了两百钱，每次途经城镇时，都会给他带上一些好吃食解馋。
如此一来，哪怕后面的路途依旧辛苦，却比刚离乡时好上了不少。
等一行人费劲千辛万苦抵达靖安城郊的军堡时，百十个役丁罕见的没有掉太多体重，至少精神状态看起来还行。
“乡亲们，送君千里终有一别，今天交了差我们就回去了。
你们在这营中好好过活，凡事忍一忍，三年辅兵期快得很，到时候我们再来接你等回乡。”
“小郎君，你和他们不一样，你八成要入战兵正卒，凡事能不忍就别忍。
趁年轻血气旺，打出点威名，才好在这营中长久立足。”
或许是到了异地他乡，也或许是这些天风雨共度处出了些情感。
几位差役的乡党之情突然发作，他们真诚的给出建议，希望自己的乡人不要没于他乡。
“大差放心，咱们都是老实的庄稼汉，家里也有婆娘孩子等着，断然不会惹事生非。”

村汉们积极表态，诉说自己的本分，周元却握紧手中的残破铁枪，目视军营的方向点了点头。
一群无野心者能忍，一个存野望者要狠。
自古以来文武两条路，就是人类社会中的上升通道，既然文事行不通，那就只能以武立身了。
“走了乡亲们，让我等再送你们最后一程。”
宽大的军堡宛若一座小城，只不过内部没有百姓，只有战兵与辅兵。
在差役的带领下，役丁们在军堡门前排好了队列，等待靖安参军的检验。
那壮硕军汉在人群中走了一圈后，眉头紧锁、面露不愉，仿佛并不满意这次的役丁质量。
两个领头的差役忙上前小声解释，不时还对着周元的方向指指点点。
“若所言属实，这些人我就收下了。”
“我等小人怎敢欺骗将军，将军一验便知。”
被十几个亲兵簇拥的靖安参军，在差役的指引下来到了周元面前。
“听过你是个勇武之人，敢刺熊搏命，县中认证的文书拿给我来看看。”
“诺。”
差役们之前叮嘱过，军中领命皆用‘诺’，将军若问起话来，先领命再行动。
靖安参军从周元手中接过文书，看了一眼乐吉县公印后，终于满意的点了点头。
“可敢进武威营，入正卒军户。”
content_en:
The Lingshen Pills given by Magistrate Zheng are ordinary items, not special items with game prompts.
Zhou Yuan could not judge the specific effect of these spiritual ginseng pills, but he thought that a county magistrate would not deceive him, a country boy.
He spent the money anyway, and he spent it in front of the servants.
This not only reduces a lot of trivial matters, but also balances the gap between the rich and the poor within the small group of servants.
"Shitou, why did you spend all your money? I'm not telling you how good you are at saving it.
If you have more money later, you can ask for a wife, so that you can leave a heir for your old Zhou family. "
"I really forgot about this if you didn't tell me. Didn't you just get one hundred and ten dollars? Lend me some first."
"I can't borrow it. Apart from this, it's easy to talk about. I still have to save money for my children and find a wife."
It's a good thing that Zhou Yuan didn't have any money, otherwise there would always be a few people making plans, which would be annoying to death.
Now it's okay, it's his turn to bother others. With his efforts, although he didn't borrow much money, he got some benefits.
Several officers thought he was brave and received two hundred coins for free. Every time they passed through a town, they would bring him some delicious food to satisfy his greed.
In this way, even if the journey ahead is still hard, it will be much better than when we first left home.
By the time the group of people arrived at the military fort on the outskirts of Jingan City after all the hard work, one hundred and ten soldiers had rarely lost much weight, and at least their mental state seemed to be okay.
"Fellows, after seeing you for a long journey, you will always be farewell. We will go back today after we handed in our mission.
You can live a good life in this camp and be patient with everything. The three-year auxiliary period will go very quickly. Then we will come to pick you up and wait for you to return home. "
"Xiao Langjun, you are different from them. You will probably join the battle and serve as a regular soldier. Don't tolerate anything if you can't bear it.
While you are young and full of energy, you can gain some prestige so that you can gain a long-term foothold in this camp. "
Maybe it's because they're in a different place, or maybe it's because they have some emotions after spending these days together.
Several police officers suddenly showed their feelings for the villagers. They sincerely gave suggestions, hoping that their fellow villagers would not be lost in other places.
"Don't worry, Dacha. We are all honest farmers, and we have a wife and children waiting for us at home. We will definitely not cause trouble."
The villagers actively expressed their stance and told their duty, but Zhou Yuan clenched the broken iron gun in his hand, looked in the direction of the military camp and nodded.
A group of people without ambitions can tolerate it, but a person with ambitions will be ruthless.
Since ancient times, the two paths of civil and military affairs have been the path to advancement in human society. Since civil affairs are not feasible, the only way to establish one's career is through martial arts.
"Let's go, folks, let me take you on your last journey later."
The spacious military fortress is like a small city, but there are no civilians inside, only soldiers and auxiliary soldiers.
Under the leadership of the officers, the soldiers lined up in front of the military fort, waiting for Jing'an's inspection to join the army.
After the sturdy military man walked around the crowd, his brows were furrowed and his face showed displeasure, as if he was not satisfied with the quality of the service this time.
The two leading officers hurriedly stepped forward and explained in a low voice, pointing in Zhou Yuan's direction from time to time.
"If what is said is true, I will accept these people."
"How dare we, the villains, deceive the general? The general will know as soon as he checks."
Surrounded by more than a dozen soldiers, Jing'an joined the army and came to Zhou Yuan under the guidance of the officers.
"I heard that you are a brave man who dared to stab a bear to death. Show me the document certified by the county."
"No."
The officers had previously warned that the word "nuo" is used when receiving orders in the army. If the general asks about something, he should first receive the order before taking action.
Jing'an joined the army and took the document from Zhou Yuan. After taking a look at the official seal of Leji County, he finally nodded with satisfaction.
"You dare to enter the Wuwei camp and enter the military household of a regular soldier."
